# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 with WASM and performance gains** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths from native interop to managed C#. It also improves WASM exception-handling support with new Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11, and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Bundles the m151 engine along with several rounds of merged upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **Managed color and pixel-format ports for lower overhead** — Ports SKColor -> SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply to managed C#, and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor hex parsing. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **Allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp hot paths** — Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free, removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData** — Fixes a leak when decoding from an SKData with an SKRectI subset. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to correct a CPU raster regression. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Platform

- **WASM exception handling improved for .NET 11** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception-handling model, plus a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Ships the allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8, the Tag.Parse allocation fix, and the zero-copy SKShaper glyph reads.
